source.exact_excerpt:
I2.2.5 The boundary between the bottom and lower regions is to be taken at the point where
         the shell is inclined 7° from horizontal.

scope: Represented sampled bottom/lower-region boundary points only; not reconstruction or geometric certification of the whole hull boundary.
